title: A step toward: No circuit of fan-in-two AND/OR gates with at most 124 gates computes the incidence function of the projective plane of order 4 (step 2 of 2)
formal_statement: have x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∀ (x2 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x2) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x3 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x3 < (21 : ℕ) ∧ (21 : ℕ) ≤ ↑x4 ∧ (↑x4 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x3) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ x2 x3 = Bool.true ∧ x2 x4 = Bool.true; have x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → ℕ := fun (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => List.countP (fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.casesOn x3.op Bool.false Bool.true Bool.false (fun (x4 : ℕ) => Bool.false) Bool.false) x2.gates; have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → List (ℕ × ℕ) := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => PEqualNP.ReadK.doubleReread x3 (42 : ℕ) (fun (x4 : ℕ) => Decidable.decide ((21 : ℕ) ≤ x4)) (List.flatMap (fun (x4 : ℕ) => List.map (fun (x5 : ℕ) => (x4, (21 : ℕ) + (x4 + x5) % (21 : ℕ))) [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) (List.range (21 : ℕ))); ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (42 : ℕ) x4 → x1 x4 → (∀ (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (42 : ℕ) x7 → x1 x7 → x2 x4 ≤ x2 x7) → x3 x4 ≠ [] → ∃ (x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (42 : ℕ) x9 ∧ x1 x9 ∧ x2 x9 ≤ x2 x4 ∧ (x3 x9).length < (x3 x4).length
plain_statement: Step 2 of 2 of a checked cut of L-meta-4201.
